title: horizon names each story whose children are all done and each sprint whose items are all done, with the command that finishes it
goal: backlog.py horizon lists, per sprint, a story whose children are all done as 'finish with done ID' and a sprint whose items are all done as 'close with close SP', so finished work is not invisible behind the next open item. Planted test: a sprint with all items done and a story with only done children are named with their command. Land it after the split of horizon into bl_view.

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();b=os.path.join(d,'kb','_self','backlog');os.makedirs(b);subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]);W=lambda it:open(os.path.join(b,it['id']+'.json'),'w').write(json.dumps(it));H=lambda:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'horizon'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;C=[{'run':['python3','-c','pass']}]
W({'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','kind':'sprint','title':'S','status':'active','goal':'g','gates':[{'id':'start','kind':'blocking','question':'Q?','options':['approve'],'recommendation':'approve','answer':'approve','by':'operator'}]})
W({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','kind':'story','title':'A','status':'doing','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P2','rank':0,'goal':'g','checks':C})
W({'id':'TK-aaaaaaaa','kind':'task','title':'T','status':'todo','parent':'ST-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P2','rank':0,'goal':'g','touches':['src/x'],'checks':C})
W({'id':'ST-rrrrrrrr','kind':'story','title':'R','status':'todo','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','review':True,'priority':'P1','rank':999999,'goal':'g','checks':C})
o0=H();t=json.load(open(os.path.join(b,'TK-aaaaaaaa.json')));t['status']='done';W(t);o1=H()
for i in ('ST-aaaaaaaa','ST-rrrrrrrr'):
    t=json.load(open(os.path.join(b,i+'.json')));t['status']='done';W(t)
o2=H();R=['finish with' not in o0 and 'close with' not in o0,'finish with python3 _tools/backlog.py done ST-aaaaaaaa' in o1,'all done: close with python3 _tools/backlog.py close SP-aaaaaaaa' in o2 and 'finish with' not in o2]
print(R);sys.exit(0 if all(R) else 1)
